technology.title: Microencapsulated flame-retardant additives
technology.text: The project is based on functional microcapsules integrated into polymer compositions for cable materials. The approach is intended to improve thermal stability and resistance to combustion.

hero.title: An engineering approach to material fire safety
hero.text: Energy Plastic works on technology solutions for cable products, combining materials science, industrial engineering practice and commercialization tasks.

mission.title: Improve infrastructure safety through new materials
mission.text: The project is focused on developing domestic fire-resistant compositions and introducing them into cable products with reduced smoke and gas emissions.
mission.panel: Energy Plastic brings together functional-material development and industrial implementation.

principles.title: Technology-driven
principles.text: Based on experimental research, materials engineering and reproducible technological processes.

principles.title: Safety
principles.text: Focused on reducing fire risks for infrastructure and high-occupancy facilities.

principles.text: Developing domestic production and reducing logistics dependence.

focus.title: From the laboratory to serial production
focus.text: The project has reached TRL 6 and is preparing for the next stage: pilot-industrial testing, certification and production scale-up.

hero.title: Microcapsules as a functional element of flame protection
hero.text: The developed approach uses microencapsulated flame-retardant additives to influence polymer-material behavior during heating and combustion.

steps.title: Microcapsule formation
steps.text: Creating a functional core and protective shell with controlled morphology.

steps.title: Stabilization
steps.text: UF and PMMA shells preserve the functional component and improve thermal stability.

steps.title: Integration
steps.text: Microcapsules are introduced into the polymer composition used in cable materials.

steps.title: Testing
steps.text: Thermal characteristics, resistance to combustion and material stability are evaluated.

research.title: Validated development results
research.panel: Microcapsule thermal stability reported in the project’s laboratory research results.
items: The effectiveness of UF and PMMA shells was experimentally confirmed.
The phase-transition temperature increased from 49°C to 120°C.
Self-extinguishing behavior was observed in combustion tests.
Prototypes were created and laboratory tests were completed.

standards.title: Aligned with industry requirements
standards.text: The project documentation references GOST, IEC and TR CU 004/2011 requirements. The final list of certificates and permits will be formed as the project moves through the industrial stage.

fire.title: Resistance to combustion
fire.text: Material behavior under high temperatures and open flame is being studied.

stability.title: Material stability
stability.text: Microcapsule morphology, thermal stability and reproducibility of properties are monitored.

hero.title: Materials and cable solutions for increased fire-safety requirements
hero.text: The project focuses on developing a fire-resistant composition and applying it in cable products for critical facilities.

main.title: AVVGng(A)-LSLTx
main.text: A cable solution with reduced smoke and gas emissions and resistance to flame propagation, designed to incorporate microencapsulated flame-retardant components.
main.panel: The project’s flagship direction for facilities with increased fire-safety requirements.

materials.title: Fire-resistant compositions as a standalone technology platform
materials.text: The developed technology is considered not only as part of a single cable product, but also as a basis for adapting functional compositions to different cable-material requirements.
materials.panel: Microencapsulated functional additives as a technology foundation for polymer compositions.

use.title: Where these solutions matter most

hero.title: Development and production of domestic fire-resistant compositions for cable manufacturing
hero.text: A commercialization project focused on developing domestic technology, preparing production capacity and moving toward industrial production.

goal.title: Production and commercial sale of cable with enhanced fire safety
goal.text: The project aims to produce AVVGng(A)-LSLTx for high-occupancy facilities and critical infrastructure.

problem.title: Increasing fire and technological safety requirements
problem.text: Standard cable solutions can create additional fire risks through flame propagation and smoke generation. Critical infrastructure especially needs local solutions aligned with modern safety requirements.

local.title: Local production
local.text: The project is focused on developing production capacity in Kazakhstan and reducing logistics risks.

hero.title: Science, production and commercialization in one project team
hero.text: The project brings together specialists in cable production, materials, marketing and financial support.

members.name: Ruslan Kaliyev
members.short: More than 15 years of experience in electric power engineering and cable manufacturing.
members.bio: Graduated from the International Transport and Humanities University in Electric Power Engineering. Worked as head of the cable production department at Zhalyn. Since 2024, he has managed a cable manufacturing plant and is responsible for quality, production processes and commercial strategy.

members.name: Aydyn Akhmetzhanov
members.short: Specialist in marketing, sales, CRM and market-channel development.
members.bio: Has an educational background in international economics, trade and finance. Implemented and optimized CRM systems, improved sales and marketing collaboration, conducted market segmentation and optimized advertising budgets.

members.name: Indira Ilyasova
members.short: Financial support, budget control and reporting.
members.bio: Responsible for project accounting, financial-flow control, tax and HR reporting, timely fulfillment of financial obligations and financial support for the project lead.

members.name: Omirzak Kapizov
members.short: Research in functional materials and scale-up of technology solutions.
members.bio: Researcher at the Research Institute of New Chemical Technologies and Materials of Al-Farabi Kazakh National University. Specializes in the development and scale-up of functional materials, including solutions for energy systems and next-generation cable products.

members.name: Dauren Mukhanov
members.short: Laboratory research, analysis and validation of results.
members.bio: Experienced in research work, development and implementation of scientific and technical solutions, laboratory and production environments, and the analysis, interpretation and validation of experimental results.
